overview: The Company Management drop-in provides API functions for managing company structures, users, roles, permissions, and credit, enabling complete B2B company administration workflows.

formData.description: An object containing the role configuration including role name, permissions array, and any custom attributes. The structure depends on your company's role configuration requirements.

variables.description: An object of type `DeleteCompanyRoleVariables` containing the role ID to delete. See the type definition for the exact structure.

id.description: The unique identifier for the company structure node (team or division) to delete. This removes the node and may reassign users depending on your company's configuration.

params.description: An object of type `DeleteCompanyUserParams` containing the user ID to delete and any additional parameters required for user deletion.

getCompany.description: Retrieves complete information about the current company including name, structure, settings, and metadata. Returns the full company profile for the authenticated user's company context.
getCompany.returns: Returns a Promise that resolves to a `CompanyModel` object containing comprehensive company details.

getCompanyCredit.description: Retrieves the company's credit information including available credit, credit limit, outstanding balance, and currency. This is used to display company credit status and validate purchase limits.
getCompanyCredit.returns: Returns a Promise that resolves to a `CompanyCreditModel` object containing credit details.

params.description: An optional object of type `GetCompanyCreditHistoryParams` containing pagination parameters (currentPage, pageSize) and optional filters. Omit to retrieve history with default pagination.

variables.description: An object of type `GetCompanyRoleVariables` containing the role ID to retrieve. Returns complete role details including permissions and assigned users.
An optional object of type `GetCompanyRolesVariables` containing pagination and filter parameters. Omit to retrieve all company roles with default pagination.

getCompanyStructure.description: Retrieves the hierarchical organization structure of the company including all teams, divisions, and reporting relationships. Returns the complete company tree structure.
getCompanyStructure.returns: Returns a Promise that resolves to a `CompanyStructureModel` object representing the organizational hierarchy.

id.description: The unique identifier for a specific company structure node (team or division). Returns detailed information about that node including its position in the hierarchy and assigned users.
The unique identifier for the company user to retrieve. Returns complete user profile including role, team assignment, and permissions.

params.description: An optional object of type `CompanyUsersParams` containing pagination and filter criteria (currentPage, pageSize, filter). Omit to retrieve all users with default pagination.

getCustomerRolePermissions.description: Retrieves the current customer's role-based permissions within the company. Returns permission flags indicating what company management actions the user is authorized to perform (manage users, approve purchases, view reports, etc.).
getCustomerRolePermissions.returns: Returns a Promise that resolves to a `CustomerRolePermissionsModel` object containing boolean permission flags for various company actions.

config.description: An optional configuration object of type `CompanyDropinConfig` containing initialization settings such as langDefinitions for internationalization. If omitted, default configuration is used.

variables.description: An object of type `IsCompanyRoleNameAvailableVariables` containing the role name to check for availability. Returns a boolean indicating whether the name can be used for a new role.

params.description: An object of type `UpdateCompanyRoleParams` containing the role ID and fields to update (name, permissions array, status). See the type definition for complete structure.
An object of type `UpdateCompanyUserStatusParams` containing the user ID and the new status value (active, inactive). Used to enable or disable user access to company resources.

formData.description: An object containing the company registration information including company name, legal name, email, VAT/TAX ID, and resale number. The structure depends on your store's company registration requirements.

id.description: The unique identifier for the company team (structure node) to delete. This removes the team and may reassign team members depending on your company's configuration.
The unique identifier for the company team to retrieve. Returns detailed information about the team including its name, members, and position in the company hierarchy.
